summary: Commit 254c5266 matches the current event-time-session-window-processor tree and would not be rejected for a current Edition 3 structural, environment, security, metadata, or packaging rule. Required flat layout, canonical task.toml, separate digest-pinned verifier, baked pins, tmux/asciinema, binary reward, and sub-limit environment size all hold. Remaining notes are preferences, not rejection-level defects.

evidence.observation: Canonical top-level fields before tables: version 2.0, name matches folder, Software/Systems, 5 tags, languages python, difficulty advanced, expert_time_estimate_hours 10, artifacts=["/app/sessions"]. environment_mode=separate, agent timeout_sec=7200 (1800-18000), network_mode=public, workdir=/app, 2 CPU / 8192 MB / 10240 MB. No removed Edition 2 fields; no compose flags on a single-container task.

Tracked tree is the flat Edition 3 layout: task.toml, instruction.md, README.md, environment/Dockerfile, environment/.dockerignore, solution/solve.sh, tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/test_outputs.py. No rubrics, milestones, jobs/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, skills.md, or task-local .cursor/. Git commit 254c5266 has no diff against the current task tree.

Final FROM is the canonical Python digest public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.13-slim-bookworm@sha256:01f42367a0a94ad4bc17111776fd66e3500c1d87c15bbd6055b7371d39c124fb. One apt transaction installs tmux and asciinema with --no-install-recommends and list cleanup; no apt upgrade or apt pins. Narrow COPY sessions/; chmod only two binaries; no FROM --platform, nproc, privileged, docker.sock, heredoc sources, reserved-path mkdir, or COPY of solution/tests.

Separate verifier image uses the same canonical digest. Pip installs from requirements.lock with --no-deps (pytest==8.4.1, pytest-json-ctrf==0.3.5 and declared transitives). Copies test.sh, test_outputs.py, and fixtures only. Does not create /logs/verifier at build. WORKDIR /app creates the parent of declared artifact /app/sessions. No explicit RUN mkdir -p /app/sessions.
Unix LF shebang. Creates /logs/verifier only at runtime, writes reward 0 then 1/0 after pytest, installs nothing, uses TEST_DIR default /tests, no trailing exit $?.
36 pytest functions each with a docstring. Grades live /app/sessions state via the public CLI. Ruff check passed. No callable end-to-end session solver. Hidden fixtures stay under /tests/fixtures.
Present; excludes .git, pycache, .env, solution/, and tests/. Intentionally does not exclude *.log so processor-bounce.log ships.

Two paragraphs, 231 words, 0 bullets, no task name, no relative paths, no canary strings. Names /app/sessions outputs and points at /app/sessions/docs/session-contract.md as binding, including the Paths table for open_sessions.json and catalog.sqlite.
176 files, 6.182 MiB total, largest file click_ledger.jsonl at 2.64 MiB; no file exceeds 50 MiB. Under the 100 MiB environment cap.
Packet task_commit exists and has an empty diff against the current task tree. Latest commit touching the task is 254c526. No tracked pycache, .terminus, rubrics, or jobs inside the task.
Controlling rules for layout, task.toml, digest-pinned canonical base, tmux/asciinema, baked pins, separate verifier, artifact parents, runtime-only /logs/verifier, and binary reward.

findings.criterion: TERMINUS_3_AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md §4 Artifacts / §9 tests/Dockerfile must create artifact parents
findings.why_it_matters: Explicit RUN mkdir -p /app/sessions is the usual Harbor parent-dir pattern. WORKDIR /app already creates the parent of artifacts=["/app/sessions"], so this is a preference rather than a missing-parent violation.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: add RUN mkdir -p /app/sessions in tests/Dockerfile without creating /logs/verifier at build.
findings.regression_risk: Low; changing only mkdir would not alter grading semantics.

findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: add org.opencontainers.image.source, .revision, and .created when those values are known.
